# ShramkoGSFPV

> Open-source (MIT) browser FPV drone simulator for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. Fly any public SuperSplat scan with quadcopter physics (4 motors, mixer, rate PID, Betaflight/Actual/KISS/Raceflight rate curves), voxel collisions with real crashes, and your EdgeTX radio over WebHID, a gamepad or touch sticks. WebGPU + PlayCanvas. Author: Andrii Shramko. Status: pre-alpha (September 2026) — research and measurements done, app in development.

Key facts (measured 2026-09-21/22):
- SuperSplat scene data and voxel collision load cross-origin (CORS *) into a third-party page; the scene metadata API does not.
- WebGPU with GPU radix sort of Gaussians is active in PlayCanvas Engine 2.22.3 (gsplat.currentRenderer === 2).
- A 3.8M-Gaussian interior loads in 1.2-1.9 s.
- On the official 5 cm voxel collision, wall clearance tracks craft size (42.5 mm radius -> 72 mm median); a swept test is required to prevent tunnelling.
- Default craft: BetaFPV Pavo20 Pro class 2.2-inch cinewhoop.
